hooks.command: r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || exit 2; python3 "$r/ci/hook_codex.py" PreToolUse; codigo=$?; if [ "$codigo" -ne 0 ]; then exit 2; fi; exit "$codigo"
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; try { $p=Get-Item -LiteralPath .; while ($p -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $p.FullName '.git'))) { $p=$p.Parent }; if (-not $p) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('PAROU POR SEGURANCA: checkout nao encontrado.'); exit 2 }; & (Join-Path $p.FullName 'ci/hook_codex.cmd') PreToolUse; $codigo=$LASTEXITCODE; if ($codigo -ne 0) { exit 2 }; exit $codigo } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('PAROU POR SEGURANCA: launcher Codex indisponivel. Confira ci/hook_codex.cmd e Python 3.11+.'); exit 2 }"
